extra.reason: Findings posted as a bd comment on this child: per-driver answers (claude/codex/opencode/kimi+cursor+grok ACP) to all four questions with file:line citations, plus one verbatim-implementable detection rule for the EpicRunner and its fallback. Key result: turn end is thread.session-set leaving 'running', but the final assistant text is dispatched AFTER that event (ProviderRuntimeIngestion.ts:1435 vs :1637-1671), so the runner must debounce on thread.message-sent before reading getThreadDetailSnapshot; assistant text is buffered in memory by default (enableAssistantStreaming=false) and ACP providers carry no item.completed detail fallback. Recommended rule: whole-line case-sensitive /^[ \t]*RALPH_DONE[ \t]*$/m on the last assistant message of the turn, cross-checked against git HEAD movement (mirroring run.sh:322-343), with 'bd ready --parent <epic>' emptiness as the structural stop instead of a .ralph-done file. Zero commits.

Matrix delivered as a bd comment on this child, every cell backed by observed output from 12 real turns across claude/codex/opencode/kimi in an isolated t3code dev stack. Headlines: skill loading holds on claude (128 slash commands) and codex (90 skills incl. 79 from ~/.agents/skills, so no ~/.codex/skills symlink is needed); typed-name expansion works natively on claude, codex ($name) and kimi, and BREAKS only on opencode; the '-' stacking idiom works only on codex (claude and kimi expand just the first /name); kimi never emits available_commands_update; Workflow and SendMessage are claude-only and codex has neither subagents nor AskUserQuestion. Research child — no commits.

Implemented in 861de9dc2. BeadsStatusBroadcaster (apps/server/src/beads/) mirrors VcsStatusBroadcaster: .beads/metadata.json detection, fs.watch on the .beads dir filtered to last-touched with 300ms debounce and a 45s poll fallback, snapshots from 'bd list --json --status=all' + 'bd ready --json' run sequentially through ProcessRunner with exponential-backoff retry on dolt lock contention, refcounted per-workspace watchers, fingerprint-gated publishing. Contracts add BeadsStatusInput/BeadsStatusResult (tagged available/unavailable with no-beads | bd-not-found | bd-failed) plus subscribeBeadsStatus and beads.refreshStatus, registered at orchestration read scope in ws.ts and wired via BeadsLayerLive in server.ts. Read-only: the server never writes beads, and 'bd show' is deliberately unused because it rewrites the last-touched file the watcher reacts to. Verification: 10 focused tests pass (parser against a recorded fixture, epic child-count summarization, transient-failure classification, no-beads, missing-bd, watch debounce/release, attach re-read), server.test.ts 112 pass, typecheck and lint clean on t3/@t3tools/contracts/@t3tools/client-runtime.

Shipped in commit ae4453b58 (branch mine). Migration 034_EpicRuns adds epic_runs + epic_run_iterations; EpicRunStore lands in persistence/Services/EpicRuns.ts (schemas + Context.Service tag) and persistence/Layers/EpicRuns.ts (EpicRunStoreLive), with EpicRunId added to contracts/baseSchemas.ts, EpicRunStoreError plus a {runId} correlation member in persistence/Errors.ts. Rehydration works off listRuns("running") plus the store's own turn_status: an iteration still recorded as running when the process boots is by definition abandoned, so no projection_turns join is needed. appendIteration is a plain INSERT so a duplicate (run_id, iteration_index) is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint, and the test asserts that failure via Effect.flip rather than counting rows. listRuns fails (not skips) on an undecodable row. Verification: 034_EpicRuns.test.ts + Layers/EpicRuns.test.ts green, full apps/server/src/persistence suite 16 files / 31 tests green, contracts and t3 typechecks exit 0, lint and fmt clean on all 9 files. Review-driven hardening: the decode branch, the {runId} correlation (in RepositoryErrorCorrelation.test.ts), and the deliberate absence of a redundant iterations index are each covered by a mutation-checked test. No layer wiring, no runner loop, no WS/HTTP - left to .11 and .13.

EpicRunner landed in commit 61d594e7b. apps/server/src/runner/ holds the service tag, the Live layer, and ralphProtocol.ts (the RALPH_DONE/RALPH_BLOCKED/RALPH_MSG contract). Started from serverRuntimeStartup's reactors phase; layer wired via ProviderRuntimeLayerLive with EpicRunStore + ProcessRunner provided by the consumer per .10's convention. Each iteration is a fresh thread.create + thread.turn.start awaited to terminal turn state, classified per t3code-vst.2's rule with a git HEAD cross-check, then thread.session.stop. Failures retry with capped backoff (3 -> failed); the run.sh gutter rule stops a run after 2 commitless iterations. 28 focused tests pass (vp test run src/runner/); typecheck, lint and fmt clean.
